The contract is likely to 01-12-2026 to 30-11-2028 for the period of two years, unl ess it is curtailed or terminated by this Office owing to deficiency of service, sub-st andard quality of personnel deployed, breach of contract, reduction or cessation of the requirements of work or indiscipline. ii. The contract shall automatically expire after two year from commencement of the contract unless extended further by the mutual consent of contracting Agency and this Office. iv. The contract may be extended, on the same terms and conditions or with some a ddition/deletion/ modification’ for a further period not exceeding 3 months at the s ole discretion of Office of the Principal Commissioner of Income Tax ,Kozhikode. v. The contracting Company/ Firm/ Agency will be required to pay minimum wages a s prescribed under the Minimum Wages as per Acts under Central/ State Governm ent.The contracting agency will maintain proper records as required underthe Law/ Acts. The requirement of this office may further increase or decrease during the period

of contract and the contracting agency would have to provide additional staff, if re quired on the same terms and conditions. vii. The contracting Company/ Firm/ Agency shall not be allowed to transfer, assign, pl edge or sub-contract its rights and liabilities under this contract to any other Agen cy without the prior written consent of this Office. viii.The tendered will be bound by the details furnished by it to this Office, while submi tting the tender or at any subsequent stage. In case any of the documents furnishe d by it is found to be false at any stage, it would be deemed to be a breach of ter ms of contract, making the tendered liable for legal action besides the termination /cancellation of contract, legal action for damages at the sole discretion of Income Tax Officer, Kalpetta and in such eventuality, the performance security amount te ndered shall be liable to be forfeited. ix. Financial bids of only those renderers shall be evaluated who are declared technic ally qualified. x. The Office of the Income tax officer, Kalpetta reserves the right to terminate the c ontract at any time after without giving any notice. xi. The contracting Agency shall ensure that the manpower deployed in the Office of t he Income Tax Officer, Kalpetta conforms to the eligibility conditions of age, educa tion and any other qualification as specified in the contract. xii. The manpower employed by the Agency shall be required to work as per the timin gs stipulated by the Officer of Income Tax, Kalpetta i.e. from Monday to Saturday f rom 07:30 hrs to 16:30 hrs with a lunch break of ½ hour from 13:15 hrs to 13:45 h rs. xiii. The contracting Company/ Firm/ Agency shall furnish the following document s in respect of the persons who will be deployed by it in this Department before th e commencement of work. a) List of persons shortlisted by Agency for deployment in the Office of the Inco me Tax Officer, Mayos Building, 2nd Floor,Kalpetta,Wayanad-673122 containi ng Name, complete residential address, father’s name, date of birth, marital status, educational and professional qualification, experience etc. b) Bio-data of the person with photograph affixed. xiv. In case, the person employed by the successful Company/ Firm/ Agency performs any act of omission/ commission that amounts to misconduct / indiscipline/ incomp etence and security risks, the successful Company/ Firm/ Agency will be liable to t ake appropriate disciplinary and legal action against such persons, including their removal from site of work, if required by the Office immediately after being brough t to their notice. xv. The service provider shall provide identity cards carrying the photograph of the pe rsonnel and personal information including name, date of birth, address, designati on etc. and uniforms to the personnel deployed in this Office. xvi. The service provider shall ensure that any details of office, operational process, te chnical know-how, Security arrangements, and administrative/ organizational matt ers are not divulged or disclosed to any person by its personnel deployed in the Of fice.

xvii. The service provider shall ensure proper conduct of its personnel in office pr emises, maintenance of strict discipline in and around the office premises and enfo rce prohibition of consumption of alcoholic drinks, chewing pan, smoking, loitering without work etc. or consuming any other intoxicant substance, food or drink durin g the work hours / being on duty to maintain discipline and office decorum. xvi. The persons deployed shall be required to report for work at 07:30 AM to the person in charge in proper unif orm under whom they are deployed which will be intimated separately and would leave at 04:30 PM. In case, a person deployed is absent on a particular day one day’s wage shall be deducted. xvii. The Agency shall depute a person in charge, out of the deployed personnel, who would be responsible for im mediate supervision of the House Keeping Staffs deployed at Income Tax Office, Kalpetta so that optimal ser vices of the persons deployed by the agency could be availed without any disruption. However the office of I ncome Tax Officer, Mayos Building, Kainatty, Kalpetta, WAYANAD - 673122 shall be fully competent and emp owered to remove any indiscipline personnel / staff from its premises if his/ her behavior is not up-to the mar k, immoral and / or his /her presence is prejudicial / embarrassing to the department. xviii. The selected Agency shall immediately provide a substitute in the event of any person leaving the job due to his/ her personal reasons or being removed by this office. The delay by the Agency in providing a substitute beyond three working days shall attract liquidated damages @ Rs. 100 per day ( per such case) on the servi ce providing Agency, besides deduction in payment on pro- rata basis. xix. It will be the responsibility of the service providing Agency to meet transportation, food, medical and any oth er requirements in respect of the persons deployed by it (Agency) in this Office and this Office will have no li abilities in this regard. xx. For all intents and purposes, the service providing Agency shall be the “Employer” within the meaning of different Labour Legislations in respect of manpower so employed and deployed in this Office. The persons d eployed by the Agency in the Office shall not have claims of any Master and Servant relationship nor have an y principal and agent relationship with or against the Office of the Income Tax Officer, Mayos building,2nd Flo or, Kalpetta, Wayanad - 673122. xxi. The service providing Agency shall be solely responsible for the redressed of grievances /resolution of dispu tes relating to persons deployed. This Office shall, in no way, be responsible for settlement of such issues wh atsoever as this office shall have no concern of contract with the work force. xxii. This Office shall not be responsible for any damages, losses, claims, financial or other, injury to any person d eployed by service providing Agency in the course of their performing the functions/ duties, or for payment t owards any compensation. xxiii. The persons deployed by the service providing Agency shall not claim nor shall be entitled to be paid, perks a nd other facilities admissible to casual, ad hoc, regular/ confirmed employees of this Office during the curren cy or after expiry of the contract. That any issue of pay, perks, statutory obligations , welfare schemes or mo netary benefits / internal arrangements of the employees , their personal insurance (If any) shall be looked a fter by the contracting agency and the department has no interference or liability of any nature in any mann er whatsoever. xxiv. In case of termination of this contract on its expiry or otherwise, the persons deployed by the service providi ng Agency shall not be entitled to and will have no claim, for any absorption nor for any relaxation for absorp tion in the regular/ other capacity in the Income Tax Officer, Mayos building,2nd Floor, Kalpetta ,Wayanad - 6 73122. In brief there shall be no privacy of contract between the department and the individuals / work force provided by the service provider / contracting agency. xxv. The contracting agency should communicate above conditions to all the persons deployed in this office by th

e contracting agency. xxvi. Payments shall be made only to the contracting agency on monthly basis as per actual services. The contra cting agency has to raise invoices in the first week of the next month for the services rendered in the month. DETAILS OF SERVICE TO BE DONE Activity Minimum Frequency 1. General Cleaning & : Twice a day Sweeping 2. Mopping of floor with the : Twice a day Disinfectants 3. Disposal of litter : Daily 4. Cleaning and disinfecting of : Twice a day Toilets 5. Cleaning of electrical fixtures : Twice in a month 6. Cleaning of name board : Twice in a month (Internal & external) 7. Washing of window panes : Daily and internal and external glass cleaning 8. Minor plumbing like closing of taps : As & when required Tightening taps, informing leakage etc. 9. Burning of garbage in Incinerator : Before 8.00 am every day 10. Pest Control/Termite Control : Half yearly in holidays as and when required. 11. Cleaning of Car porch : Every week 12. Mopping of corridor : Every three hours 13. Cleaning of tiles, using machine : Once in a Week. Note: Total requirement of staff in day to day work shall be computed by the c ontractor after visiting the premises. The tenderer while submitting bid per hea d should consider the quantum of work mentioned above as well as the minimu m wages declared As per Minimum Wages Act. No separate rate allowed for diff erent nature of work other than consumables. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF HOUSE KEEPING STAFF The person who is on shift duty will not leave his duty point without properly handing over the charge to hi

s reliever. 1. The staff must report in proper uniform of their Agency and display their Identity Cards. 2. The place of duty shall normally be at the Income Tax Office Premises but services may be utilized in any office/department for special arrangements if need so arise. 3. Cleaning, sweeping and mopping of officer’s room, staff room, canteen, corridors, waiting areas, libra ry, toilets etc. twice a day and mopping with disinfectant lotion using power equipment. Sweeping o f staircases, cleaning, dusting and mopping of railings, window sills and projected beams should be d one daily. Wet mopping of staircase railing should be done with hands daily. Cleaning, dusting of fur niture etc. should be completed well before the commencement of office. 4. Washing of with soap solution once in a week. Wet mopping, dusting of curtains, walls, windows, wall hung lights, ventilators, glass partitions/panes, exhaust fans, ceiling fans, AC blowers etc. should be done daily. 5. Maintenance of bathrooms and toilets, scrubbing of walls, washing of washbasin with disinfectants/cle aning liquids/lotion daily in the morning. Removing of cobwebs from the rooms, ceiling, toilets on da y to day basis. Bad odor from closets, washbasin, urinals is to be removed immediately. Ensure toilet s seats are kept neat and tidy. Toilets should be cleaned twice daily. 6. Emptying of dustbins and collections of garbage from the offices, canteen and other areas and burn it in the incinerator installed in the premises. The burning should be completed before 7.30 a m every day. 7. Sweeping of surrounding areas clean and free of garbage and animal/bird droppings etc. 9. Protection of equipment, fixtures, plants greenery and other movable/immovable properties of the offi ce. 10. Abuse of electricity/water/telephones services by the agency is prohibited. 11. To maintain highest order of integrity, moral and social responsibility especially towards ladies, children and senior citizens. 12. Suitable number of female sweepers to be provided as per requirement or as advised by the administ ration and instructions as given by the Authorities/ Administration Branch staff to be strictly followe d. 13. An inventory of cleaning material, equipment, tile cleaning machines and other appliances used by t he House Keeping Staff should be maintained by the Agency and should be produced whenever dire cted by the authority. 14. Scrubbing of Floors using Single Disk Scrubbing Machines at least once a week is mandatory. 15. Reporting of any missing fittings, taps or bulbs immediately to the Security Guard/ Care Taker/ Estate Officer. 16. Any other work of similar nature assigned by the authorities. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained he rein, the Office may reject an Application without being liable in any manner whatsoever to the Applic ant if it determines that the Applicant has, directly or indirectly or through an agent, engaged in corr upt practice, fraudulent practice, coercive practice, undesirable practice or restrictive practice in the Bidding Process.

ii. The Service provider shall be responsible for compliance of all statutory provisions relating to Minimu m wages, Employees’ Provident Fund, Employees State Insurance and other labour laws etc. in respec t of the persons deployed by it in this Office as this office has no privacy of contract with these employ ees. ii. The Service provider shall also be liable for depositing all taxes, levies, Cass etc. on account of service rendered by it to the Office of the Income Tax Officer, Mayos Building, Kainatty, Kalpetta ,Wayanad-67 3122 to concerned tax collection authorities from time to time as per extant rules and regulations on t he matter. iii. The Service provider shall maintain all statutory registers under the applicable laws. The Agency shall p roduce the same, on demand, to the concerned authority of this Office or any other authority under La w. iv. The Tax Deduction at Source (T.D.S.) shall be made as per the provisions of Income Tax law, as amend ed from time to time and a certificate to this effect shall be provided to the Agency by this Office. v. In case, the tendering Agency fails to comply with any statutory/ taxation liability under appropriate la w and as a result thereof this Office is put to any loss, obligation, monetary or otherwise, this Office wi ll be entitled to get itself reimbursed out of the outstanding bills or the Performance Security Deposit of the Agency, to the extent of the loss or obligation in monetary terms.

FINANCIAL i. E-Performance bank guarantee (ePBG) from a Nationalized Bank/Bank Guarantee for 3% of Total Contra cted amount for a period of 24 months is to be deposited by the successful bidder vide order No.F.6/1/2 026- VDA dated 30.09.2026. ii. The Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) amount to be deposited or submission of Bid Security Declaration wil l be done as per Rule 170 (iii) of GFR 2017. iii. In case of breach of any terms and conditions stipulated in the contract, the performance security Deposit of the Agency will be liable to be forfeited by this Office besides annulment of the contract. iv. The Agency shall raise the bill, in triplicate, along with attendance sheet to the Division under whom the outsourced personnel has been deployed in the first week of the succeeding month. The concerned offi ce/officer will send the bills duly verified to the office of the Income Tax Officer, Mayos Building, Kainatt y, Kalpetta, Wayanad-673122 for sanction and payment. vii. The claims in bills regarding Employees State Insurance, Provident Fund, and Service Tax etc. should b e necessarily accompanied with documentary proof pertaining to the concerned month bill. A requisite portion of the bill/ whole of the bill amount shall be held up till the proof is furnished, at the discretion of this Office. viii. Settlement of disputes will be as per Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act-1996 and venue will be th e Office of the Income Tax Officer, Mayos Building, Kainatty, Kalpetta , Wayanad-673122. It is clarifie d that the sole arbitrator to adjudicate any disputes arising out of the proposed contract shall be nominated / appointed by Income Tax Officer, Wayanad. ix.
